messages:
maria: Morning all — final squeeze window. Planning to cut 0.30.1 at 20:00 UTC today. Quick checklist: version bump merged? changelog entry? docs spotcheck? security signoff? canary smoke green? Owners please respond.
kevin: Branch fanout done. PR #5423 merged to release/v0.30.x. Left 2 small lint fixes in CI, will patch before cutoff. cc @maria
jon: Smoke suite running on canary. 5 failing tests flaky; rerunning. If green in 15m I'll post report.
sarah: Docs: quick changelog added, but need a screenshot update for config page. Can do in 30m.
security-bot: SCA scan completed — no critical vulnerabilities. dependency update note in PR.
aleksa-qa: QA checklist: regression suite running (parallel). Blockers: one perf regression on long-seq tests, investigating.
maria: Ok — two outstanding: docs screenshot and perf regression. If either unresolved at 19:30 UTC we delay cutoff to 21:00. Also need sign-off from security and QA.
kevin: LGTM for version bump. :thumbsup:
jon: Canary now 100% of staging; smoke passes 98/100; reran flaky tests — all green. Link: https://ci.redwood/exec/1234
sarah: I'll drop screenshot PR in 20m: #5432
security-bot: Security approves for release: "approved-by: sec-team/fastpath" — audit note: CVE-2024-9999 patched.
aleksa-qa: QA sign-off pending perf fix. If we can't reproduce perf in prod sim, will sign-off. ETA 35m.
maria: Pastin g final checklist:
```
- bump package.json -> version 0.30.1
- changelog entry in docs/changelog/0.30.md
- merge release branch -> main
- tag v0.30.1
- trigger deploy job: deploy/release-0.30.1
- monitor canary for 30m
- rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m wait
- rollback on >2% error rate or latency +30%
```
maria: Also run the cut command:
```
git checkout release/v0.30.x
git merge --no-ff main
git tag -a v0.30.1 -m "v0.30.1"
git push origin v0.30.1
```
kevin: Noted. I'll handle the tag and push if we hit green.
jon: Rolling canary watch now. will ping on anomalies.
sarah: PR #5432 created: screenshot + minor wording. link: https://git.redwood/pr/5432
aleksa-qa: Perf regression traced to a coeff in batching; patch PR #5433, running perf job now.
maria: If perf patch passes, we cut at 20:00 UTC. If not, fallback plan: cut minor hotfix at 23:00 after deeper perf triage. Everyone ok?
kevin: OK from me.
jon: OK
sarah: ok
security-bot: confirmed post-patch scan queued.
aleksa-qa: Perf patch looks good: median latency back in range. QA sign-off: ✅
maria: Great — proceeding with cutoff. tagging in 10m. Thanks team :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Deploy job triggered: deploy/release-0.30.1 — build 2024.5.78 — status: in progress
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 10% -> 50% in progress
jon: Canary stable at 50% after 15m, error rate 0.04%
maria: CUT complete — tag pushed, changelog live, docs PR merged. Shipping.
kevin: pushing release notes to product
sarah: updated screenshot in prod: looks good.
aleksa-qa: final smoke run green.
maria: closing thread — thanks all. :tada:
